slots.value: Lifted shingles, failed flashing and leaks found and repaired by the crew Austin homeowners have called since 2004.
The problems we fix most on Austin roofs.
We trace the water to its source and fix the cause, not just the stain.
Loose and missing shingles replaced to match the roof.
Failed flashing around chimneys and vents resealed.
Small storm damage patched before the next rain.
Three steps, explained as we go.
We inspect the roof and find where the water gets in.
You get a written estimate before any work starts.
The crew repairs the damage and checks the area around it.
What to do and what to expect.
What should I do when I find a leak?
Move valuables away from the drip, put down a bucket and call us. We will book an inspection to find the cause.
Can a leak be fixed without a new roof?
Usually. Most leaks come from one failed spot, and a repair solves it when the rest of the roof is sound.
Will the repair match my roof?
We match the shingles as closely as we can and show you the options before we start.
Yes. Small storm damage is a repair, and for bigger damage we help you with the insurance claim.
How do I book a repair?
Call (512) 555-0142 or book on the contact page and we will arrange the inspection.
Book the first available inspection and we will find the cause and fix it.
Call us to talk through repairs before small problems grow.
